--- change 2 (repo omnibase_core, pull request #1460) ---
fix(OMN-14711): arch-no-raw-sqlite3 detects sqlite3 submodule imports (#1460)
visit_Import only recorded the sqlite3 alias when alias.name == 'sqlite3'
exactly. A submodule import (import sqlite3.dbapi2) binds the root sqlite3
name but sets alias.name to the dotted path, so a subsequent
sqlite3.connect(...) evaded the gate (false negative). Treat an import
whose alias.name starts with 'sqlite3.' and carries no asname as binding
the sqlite3 root alias. The asname guard avoids a false positive on
'import sqlite3.dbapi2 as foo', which binds foo (the submodule) not root.

Adds a RED-proving negative fixture plus false-positive-guard and di-ok
suppression cases. Only widens detection; di-ok suppression and _adapter.py
exclusion unchanged.

was first-match by declaration order and ignored both the documented

runtime bootstrap with no attribution to the offending contract/handler.

path, with an identifying TypeError naming the handler module.name and owning
contract.
